items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: But many nights I'd just spend time... In his place, of course, for a week... if he'd work Sunday night... I'd work Sunday in his place

ctx.x: How many days you had steady you worked with Chris? Were you a member of Chris's band? Who me?

Who me? No, no, no. I never remember Chris's band. I always remember Chris's band like when someone played, Harrison Bourne was working over at, in the shop, moving out of here. In the shop with a well-tooled, with a bottle of tubes. And when Harrison would get off to play, he'd say, Chris come get me. And he'd tell Chris to get me, come get me, you see. And I'd go play. And Harrison was a welder, you see. He was a welder. Flu welder they call him. A man of a job like that, you know, good and well. He'd have been…
Let's see, I thought Sonny played with Chris for a while.
